result.document_summary: Massachusetts General Laws c. 186 § 31, requiring a landlord's notice to quit for nonpayment of rent to be accompanied by an informational form and preventing courts from accepting summary process filings without proof of its delivery.
result.notes: This section covers only procedural notice requirements for nonpayment-of-rent notices to quit (an information form and a court filing prerequisite). It does not state allowed eviction causes, relocation assistance, or coverage tests, so it does not set out a just-cause eviction regime or any other in-scope rule. Nothing else in the document falls within the six categories, so no rules are extracted.
